target.title: fix(feishu): refresh client after invalid token
target.body:
## Summary

- Refresh the cached Feishu client when send/reply/card-send sees Feishu invalid token codes `99991663` or `99991664`.
- Retry the failed send path once after the refresh, covering both thrown SDK/Axios errors and fulfilled Feishu error bodies.
- Add regression coverage for invalid-token classification, one-shot refresh retry, and no infinite retry loop.

## Issue/Motivation

Fixes #97287.

Feishu can return invalid tenant/app access token errors after cached SDK auth state goes stale. Before this change, those responses were treated as terminal send failures, so operators had to manually restart the gateway to clear the cached client/token state.

## Changes

- Add `refreshFeishuClient()` to invalidate and recreate the cached Feishu client for the affected account.
- Extend `requestFeishuApi()` with an optional `onInvalidToken` hook that refreshes once before retrying invalid-token responses.
- Wire Feishu text/card send paths through a mutable client ref so the retry uses the freshly-created client.
- Add focused regression tests for `99991663` / `99991664` thrown and fulfilled response shapes.

## Testing

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/feishu/src/send.retry.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/send.test.ts` — 57 tests passed.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/feishu/src/streaming-card.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/client.test.ts` — 40 tests passed.
- `corepack pnpm exec oxlint extensions/feishu/src/client.ts extensions/feishu/src/comment-shared.ts extensions/feishu/src/send-target.ts extensions/feishu/src/send.ts extensions/feishu/src/send.retry.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/send.test.ts` — 0 warnings, 0 errors.
- `git diff --check` — passed.
- Diff secret scan — passed.

Note: `pnpm lint --threads=8` was attempted, but the full-repo lint shard timed out locally after 300s while `oxlint:core` was still running; the changed Feishu files were linted directly with oxlint as listed above.

## What Problem This Solves

Feishu send failures with invalid token codes `99991663` / `99991664` no longer require a gateway restart just to clear stale cached Feishu auth/client state. The affected send operation refreshes the account client once and retries with the fresh client, while unrelated Feishu errors still fail fast and repeated invalid-token failures stop after one refresh.

## Evidence

- Regression tests prove thrown invalid-token errors refresh once and retry successfully.
- Regression tests prove fulfilled invalid-token bodies refresh once and retry successfully.
- Regression tests prove persistent invalid-token failures do not loop forever and surface the wrapped Feishu code.
- Duplicate check immediately before publishing found no open PR referencing `#97287`, `99991663`, `99991664`, or the Feishu invalid-token direction.
- `git diff --check` and diff secret scan passed before commit.
